## Milestone review: accepted by the user
The user accepted Milestone 1 at 2026-11-02T13:00Z (chat://coordinator/u9): "I read the report. Looks good, I accept Milestone 1." The acceptance covers the existing report comment (<!-- milestone report -->, posted 2026-11-02T12:05Z), whose review state has not changed: F10 (P7) and F20 (P8) merged, R1 cut, no feature sent back, no park lifted. The acceptance is the user's; agents make no proof-pass claim. Still open: maintenance issue B30 (colour polish, left open with its recorded reason) and build-20's writer (idle, stop not confirmed, session unreadable). Both are listed in the report's Next Milestone proposals for the next planning. Closing this Milestone issue as completed.
